description: Source code for managing category boards in a SQL store, including functions for retrieving, updating, reordering, and setting visibility of category boards within the focalboard project.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer for focalboard, with methods to manage category boards.

methods.name: getUserCategoryBoards
methods.description: Retrieves category boards for a user within a team, including their metadata.

methods.name: getCategoryBoardAttributes
methods.description: Fetches attributes of category boards from the database based on category ID.

methods.name: addUpdateCategoryBoard
methods.description: Adds or updates category board associations for a user, handling deduplication and upsert logic.

methods.name: categoryBoardsFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a slice of CategoryBoardMetadata objects.

methods.name: reorderCategoryBoards
methods.description: Reorders category boards based on a new specified order.

methods.name: setBoardVisibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility (hidden or visible) of a specific board within a category for a user.
